blocking_findings.finding: Attempt 3 preserves same-content dataset/retrieval/effective observations in AlphaProcessor, but those rows cannot coexist under the frozen Stage 02 V2 schema. The new chunk_id is evidence-scoped and differs, while alpha_documents_v2_document_identity remains unique on canonical_source_id, content_hash, document_version, chunk_index, chunk_hash and embedding_version, excluding evidence_id, dataset_version and observation times. AlphaVectorStore upserts only on chunk_id. Two same-content retrieval observations therefore produce two chunk/evidence IDs but the same frozen document-identity key, causing a unique-constraint conflict rather than preserving both observations. The deterministic offline reproduction returned 2 chunks, 2 chunk IDs and 2 evidence IDs but only 1 distinct frozen document-identity tuple.

blocking_findings.finding: Historical ticker scope and snapshot identity are not enforced end to end. JsonArchiveProvider ignores the tickers/boundaries passed by AlphaLoader, and AlphaLoader trusts the provider instead of rejecting documents whose ticker is outside the requested set. An offline reproduction requesting only NVDA returned both NVDA and AMD. In addition, processor document/evidence/chunk IDs omit ticker and the materialization fingerprint hashes only those IDs, so a same-content observation reassigned between two requested tickers can retain the same fingerprint while Vector's already-written ticker and Graph's retried RawDocument ticker diverge. Multi-ticker copies of the same evidence are also treated as exact duplicates and one ticker association is lost.
blocking_findings.required_change: Enforce requested ticker membership in the historical loader independently of provider behavior and define a frozen, storage-compatible representation for multi-ticker evidence. Bind the materialization fingerprint to every Vector/Graph-relevant association and metadata field, including ticker, or to a canonical full record manifest hash. Add tests for an archive containing requested and unrequested tickers, one source associated with multiple requested tickers, and ticker/metadata changes during Graph resume.

blocking_findings.finding: Checkpoint retry is poisoned by failures that occur before materialization identity exists. Missing credentials and load/process failures save a current-attempt manifest with request_fingerprint but no materialization_fingerprint. On the next run, any loaded manifest is unconditionally required to have a materialization fingerprint after reprocessing, so the retry returns INGESTION_RESUME_FINGERPRINT_MISSING even when vector status is failed/pending and no completed work is being reused. This is fail-closed but not resumable and requires manual checkpoint deletion rather than a safe retry.
blocking_findings.required_change: Differentiate incomplete pre-materialization checkpoints from completed Vector checkpoints. Permit a safe current-request retry when no completed work can be reused, while continuing to reject missing/mismatched identity for completed Vector/Graph state. Add exact tests for missing-credential, transient load and transient process failure followed by a successful same-checkpoint retry.
